shorts.title: This Foot-Long Worm Lives in a Tiny Cricket
shorts.outro: What happens next is even worse. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: The horsehair worm spends three months coiled up inside a cricket twelve times shorter than it is, and then it needs a way out.

shorts.title: This Fungus Makes Ants Bite Down and Never Let Go
shorts.outro: And that's not even the disturbing part. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: The zombie ant fungus walks its host to the perfect leaf at noon, then wrecks its jaw so the bite locks for good.

shorts.title: This Single Cell Kills 97% of the People It Infects
shorts.outro: Doug jumps in anyway. All eighteen Doug deaths are linked below.
shorts.description: The brain-eating amoeba was never after Doug, and of 167 U.S. cases since 1962, only four people survived.
